reason: Conditionally reproduced with uv 0.13.0 and Python 3.15.0 on Linux x86_64. Using isolated directories and real tombi wheels, installed tombi@latest from a local index initially offering only 1.8.1, with configuration resolution = "lowest-direct". After adding 1.8.4, `uv tool list --outdated` advertised 1.8.4, while `uv tool upgrade --all` printed `Nothing to upgrade` and retained 1.8.1. It also emitted a lowest-resolution warning. No version constraint or exclude-newer setting was present. `uv tool upgrade --all --resolution highest` successfully upgraded to 1.8.4; default settings also upgraded successfully. The saved-strategy behavior is covered by `tool_upgrade_settings` in crates/uv/tests/tool/tool_upgrade.rs and is intentional. This additional setting is absent from the report, so the reporter’s cause remains unconfirmed; their sanitized receipt and verbose upgrade output are needed. Darwin arm64 was not tested. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with the findings.
